channel.title: Marketing Mondays
channel.description: Marketing Mondays: a Singapore community of marketers and a weekly YouTube show decoding one real market signal every Monday. Founded by SOMIN.

item.title: The 2027 marketing team: smaller, faster, or obsolete?
item.description: Signal decoded: what the 2027 marketing team looks like when AI agents take the busywork, and which human roles get more valuable, not less.

item.title: The autopsy of a lost sale
item.description: Signal decoded: how to run a blameless autopsy on a deal or customer you lost, and find the audience signal you missed before it cost you.

item.title: AI's role in creative, media and brand marketing
item.description: What we learned from the Marketing Mondays Block71 panel on AI in creative, media and brand, and the framework we still use to decide where AI leads.

item.title: Vanity metrics: the numbers that make you feel good
item.description: Signal decoded: why a 400% ROAS can hide a loss, how to spot vanity metrics in your reporting, and what to measure instead.

item.title: Will AI replace marketers? A signal-based answer
item.description: Signal decoded: what the fear of AI replacement is really about, which marketing skills are rising in value, and a 30-day plan to get ahead.

item.title: Marketer imposter syndrome: know it before you show it
item.description: Signal decoded: why so many capable marketers feel like frauds, and how evidence and peers build confidence that does not need faking.

item.title: Escaping the sea of sameness when everyone uses AI
item.description: Signal decoded: why generative AI is making brands sound alike, and how audience tensions and narrative help you stand apart.

item.title: The one signal method: how we decode a Monday episode
item.description: How Marketing Mondays picks one real market signal each week, decodes it in minutes and turns it into a takeaway you can use the same day.

item.title: Media foresight: retail media, Gen Z and the next budget
item.description: Signal decoded: why many media plans lack foresight, what retail media networks and Gen Z segmentation change, and how to plan ahead.

item.title: When AI answers replace the search results page
item.description: Signal decoded: what generative AI answers mean for brand visibility, and how marketers can earn a place in ChatGPT, Gemini and AI Overviews.
